facts.fact: El Moudjahid reports that from 5 April 2026 the municipal services work in the national vehicle-registration information system, a centralised platform that is the only channel for all transactions, the old local applications being switched off; it gives no count of communes.
facts.system: Municipal services working in the national vehicle-registration platform

facts.fact: On 5 April 2026 the municipal services began the third phase of generalising the national vehicle-registration system, ending manual and local procedures in favour of the centralised platform, El Moudjahid reports.
facts.system: Municipal services working in the national vehicle-registration platform

facts.fact: The move of municipal services onto the centralised national vehicle-registration platform on 5 April 2026 was made on the directives of the Ministry of the Interior, Local Authorities and Transport, El Moudjahid reports; the document does not say who provides or pays for the offices' connection.
facts.system: Municipal services working in the national vehicle-registration platform
